correctness.rationale: The cube loses two simplex volumes t^d/d!, its polar cross-polytope gains exactly two pyramids t/[d!(d−t)], and their product yields the exact rational formula. The derivative reduces to H_d(t), strictly increasing on (0,2). Direct endpoint calculations show roots interior precisely d=3,4,5, with all d≥6 resolved by a factorial induction from d=6. Exact rational and numerical convex-hull checks independently corroborate normalization; finite checks are not offered as infinite proofs.
